items.text: Students perform better academically, behaviorally, and emotionally when they are not hungry. Thank you to school nutrition advocates for continuing to fight for universal free meals for our students! https://t.co/myimDVo9Hy
LGBTQ care includes mental health services, AIDS treatment, domestic violence protection, and homelessness prevention. I will fight to protect the crucial services offered by these orgs.

House Republicans just passed their slash-and-burn budget that will gut Medicaid and nutrition programs—all to hand $4.5 trillion in tax breaks to billionaires. It even raises taxes on working families. 

I’m a BIG, FAT ‘HELL NO’ on this betrayal and will keep fighting to stop this ridiculous attack on Americans.  

Watch my remarks from today on the House floor:

March is National Nutrition Month — a time to focus on making informed and healthy food choices. But fresh high quality food isn’t always an option for those living paycheck to paycheck. 
 
For families in California, SNAP can help you put healthy food on the table. Learn more and apply at https://t.co/pEvPaj8VXM.

I joined a brief opposing Trump’s illegal firings of Gwynne Wilcox (NLRB) and Cathy Harris (MSPB). 
  
Wilcox fought for fair treatment and safe conditions for workers. Harris protected whistleblowers and kept the federal workforce accountable. 
  
Trump removed them without cause—violating the law and weakening the agencies that protect everyday Americans.
Americans with autism should never have to worry if their private medical records will be used against them, and I’ll fight tooth and nail to protect their privacy.

Trump’s answer to our youth mental health crisis?

Take away funding that provided our children with the mental health support they needed. We need more access to mental health resources, not less. It’s a proven way to help prevent suicides, violence and addiction.

Attacks on reproductive health — as always. 

Republicans want to block Medicaid funds from going to Planned Parenthood.

That means no federal dollars to Planned Parenthood for cancer screenings, pap tests, and STI treatment — especially in underserved communities.

(6/8)

This isn’t a budget — it’s a blueprint for dismantling democracy and silencing accountability.
 → Undermines the courts. → Blocks AI oversight. → Rewards gun lobbyists. → Punishes student borrowers. → Attacks reproductive health. → Empowers political retaliation.

(8/8)

Donald Trump just gave deportation agents access to Medicaid data — even after Medicaid officials warned it was legally and ethically wrong. This is the personal health info of people in California. 

We should never use a person’s need to go to the doctor against them. This will only lead to more chaos and pain in our communities.

On the same day the Trump Administration announced they’re ending National Suicide Prevention Lifeline's LGBTQ support services, the Supreme Court ruled that states can interfere in private medical decisions between families, doctors, and their children.

These assaults on our children and families aren’t just cruel — they’re dangerous, and they will lead to more fear, more isolation, and more loss. Gender-affirming care is essential, and denying it puts lives at risk.
The facts are clear: the GOP tax bill robs hardworking Americans of healthcare and nutrition assistance just so billionaires can get even richer.

The sun is coming up — but it’s a very dark day in America.

After hours of backroom deals and arm-twisting, Republicans are about to pass a budget nobody wants except the billionaires and large corporations who will get even more tax breaks, while millions lose health coverage, food benefits, and daycare.

House Republicans just traded away healthcare, nutrition assistance for children, and daycare for millions of their constituents who rely on them, all to give billionaires yet another tax break. That includes Republicans from California who voted to take away services they claim to support from the very communities they were elected to represent. It’s a betrayal that will hit those most in need the hardest.

Read my full statement

We have a youth mental health crisis, and not nearly enough psychologists and mental health professionals to help our young students.  

That’s why I’m proud to announce that I’m co-leading the Preparing for the Future Act with @RepJoshG This bill will address the shortage of mental health professionals by providing scholarships for student psychologists who serve at schools.

The Trump admin froze HIV prevention investments, cutting off lifesaving care across South LA. I led the fight to get this funding restored because science — not political spite — should drive public health. Glad the CDC reversed course and thankful for of the allies that stood with us and the LGBTQ community.  
https://t.co/8t9zsVMGZU

The Trump Administration is trying to roll back LGBTQ rights; but communities like West Hollywood keep pushing forward. 

Honored to join @APLAHealth for the opening of the new Michael Gottlieb Health Center, expanding care where people need it. 

https://t.co/5Pio4kHgdd

The Trump administration illegally withheld Head Start funding — blocking critical support for children in need. While they play politics with kids' futures, we won’t stop fighting to expand access to early learning, health care, and nutrition because every child deserves a strong start.

The Trump administration must release these congressionally mandated investments now.
https://t.co/SOAIsoYH1y

Republicans gutted Medicaid reimbursements for Planned Parenthood, resulting in five clinics in Northern California shutting down. Essential medical care for 2 million people is at direct risk. I’m responding by leading a bill with 130+ cosponsors to fight back. https://t.co/4Ncwv7VFum

On the first stop of my Neighborhood Healthcare Tour, I sat down with healthcare providers from Wesley Health Center who are rightfully terrified about how Trump & Republican’s $1 trillion in Medicaid cuts will affect the quality care they deliver to their patients every day. 

Preventative care, cancer screenings, and HIV prevention – those are the critical services at stake in our community. I’m not about to let those disappear without a fight.

Thankful for partners like Wesley Health Center for speaking up about the impact of the GOP’s Medicaid cuts, even in the face of Republican lies. Together, we’ll protect and expand affordable healthcare.

Today in West Hollywood, I joined @PPFA, patients, and healthcare providers to introduce the Restoring Essential Healthcare Act — reversing the GOP’s ban on Medicaid reimbursements to Planned Parenthood.

Care like cancer screenings and STI tests is essential. I won’t stop fighting to protect our healthcare from Republican’s attacks.
 
The GOP’s Big, Bad Bill didn’t just target reproductive care — it blocked millions from affordable, basic healthcare.

Our bill restores that — because no one should lose care over politics.
 
Proud to lead this fight from LA to DC with @RepNikema, @RepChrisPappas, @SenTinaSmith, @PattyMurray, @PPFA — and 130+ cosponsors.

We’re standing up for healthcare as a right.

Screenings may seem like a hassle, especially if you think you’re healthy. But knowing what to look for and taking symptoms seriously saved my life, and it may very well save yours too. 

So proud to partner with @nabtweets to promote breast cancer awareness. Get checked and tell your friends and families to make screenings a part of their healthcare routine.

The latest numbers from the Congressional Budget Office are even worse. The Republican’s Big, Bad Law will kick 10 million hardworking Americans off their healthcare and raise ACA premiums.

All to give billionaires a $1 trillion blank check while forcing more Americans into medical debt. It’s diabolical and I won’t stop fighting to protect and expand affordable care.

CHLA performs miracles everyday right here in my district. These layoffs are heartbreaking for both the world class staff that work at CHLA, and the patients that come through their doors.

I won't stop fighting to make sure that our hospitals and clinics have the support they need to take care of our children and communities.

https://t.co/64nN3XU0TN

Celebrating Labor Day with California’s incredible union members, including ILWU, IBEW, SEIU, Carpenters, and so many more. 

They’re the fuel driving our economy from clean energy to rail to our hospitals to the food on our table, and everything in between. I’ll always have their back.
